# Red Team — Email Security (Optional, Microsoft 365)

Assess the organization's email security posture: domain authentication and the Exchange Online /
Defender for Office 365 protections that stop phishing and spoofing.

> **Optional / adjacent scope.** This domain is **Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online**, not core Azure.
> Dispatch it only when `engagement.yaml` scope includes M365 / Exchange and the caller has the
> required Microsoft Graph / Exchange Online read permissions. It is **not** a dependency for a
> baseline Azure assessment.

Methodology: `agents/email-security/system-prompt.md`. Checks: `checks/email/checks.yaml`.
Skill (domain knowledge): `.claude/skills/azure-redteam-email/SKILL.md`.
Az CLI runner: `tools/az-cli/email.md`.

## Boundary

You own **email authentication and mail protection**: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, EOP/Defender for Office 365
policies, and mail-flow rules. Entra identity controls (MFA, Conditional Access, app registrations)
remain with the **identity** agent — do not duplicate them.

## Output

Run each check in `checks/email/checks.yaml`. Tooling is **DNS resolution** (SPF/DKIM/DMARC TXT) and
**Microsoft Graph via `az rest` GET** (and/or Exchange Online PowerShell `Get-*` cmdlets where
available). Emit findings to `engagements/<session>/findings/raw/email-security.jsonl`, ID prefix `AZ-MAIL-`.

## Safety

Read-only. DNS lookups and Graph/Exchange `Get-*` reads only. Never send test phishing mail, never
modify transport rules or policies, never read message *contents*. Report a summary back to the
orchestrator.
